$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFCB (AIP France, chart dated 2023-11-30): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Bagnères-de-Luchon

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD located in a mountainous region.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
When the ground is snow covered, AD reserved for home based ACFT or for ACFT equipped with skis.
Air navigation hazard Significant wind conditions that can change in a matter of minutes and compromise arrival or departure.
Slope breeze and shadow effects to be taken into account.
Pilot's attention is drawn on heavy activity gliders and hang Paraglider.
A lot of obstacles for both QFU and more especially at the South.
Preliminary reconnaissance of the site accompanied by an instructor familiar with the site or with mountain flying is highly recommended.
Highly not recommended by South wind.
No takeoff with wind oriented of 270°.
Reserved for ACFT able to follow safely the traffic circuit.
The use of QFU 187° is reserved for landing and, only in case of emergency, for motorized ACFT because of obstacles making the go around hard to execute.
Ultra light glider sector Southwest from AD.
St-Aventin valley next to ultra light glider sector, do not descend below 4000 ft AMSL.
VFR flights: contact compulsory.
Entering point by North: CIERP.
ARR and DEP on the right side of the valley.
Enter the valley only if the width of the valley not covered by the ceiling permits a turning back in safety.
Special attention when taxing on TWY due to over lapping of the side zones of releases and simultaneous movements and RWY not vacated.
Due to presence of vegetal obstacles in the East side funnel, the following recommendations must be applied: Go around in RWY 01 axis to 400 Feet; No low altitude circuit.
Gliders winching (NR 1002) on AD 4000 ft AMSL.
SR-SS, non marked cable.
Activity announced by yellow rotating light.
Users information on A/A FREQ.
